memoryRule: a one-way scan stays geometry-neutral; reversal remakes three remote solids as misregistered, sheared, and hollowed while the source solid stays exact; four errors compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch drags in one direction then reverses before release; ArrowUp/ArrowDown provides the signed scan; Enter or Space commits; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases

compositionRupture: scattered words, cellular plate, and single mould -> oblique depth-bearing cluster with occlusion, a dark missing core, and remote solid displacement
encounterRupture: touch-and-reply, press-and-cross, and mark-and-commit -> signed spatial scan whose reversal is the only committing gesture
temporalRupture: language mishearing, pressure cast, and cellular inference -> directional reversal becomes a retained depth error with four liftable states

changedRule: A one-way scan is inert. Only reversal can spend directional evidence, and it is spent in three remote solids rather than at the viewed source.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is nine irregular solids around a dark core. After reversal, the source stays exact while a remote block shifts depth and rotation, another shears and narrows, and another hollows and fades; four errors persist.
falsifier: Delete if one-way scanning changes geometry, reversal is only readout, the source solid answers itself, the blind work is a flat stack or generic 3D demo, later errors reset, or lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v042 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the volumetric misregistration from v039-v041 or if viewpoint reversal does not visibly produce remote depth geometry.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
